comments.author: Marco-Polo
comments.body: The name for the thesis is "Re-evaluating Discoveries--Hidden Values". I'm expecting to complete it today. HINT: You can repeat the same low-level quests in Northern Europe to expedite completing the quest (100 pages total--1 page for new discovery under r3, 3 pages for repeated discovery under r3, 4 pages for repeated discovery greater than or equal to r3). Plus you get an additional 3 pages for EA discoveries, but that doesn't seem practical to go to EA and then come back after about 15 discoveries to turn in your thesis, in my opinion.

comments.author: Egw
comments.body: It is a somewhat useful skills, although I have to warn people, not as useful as it appears at first sight. It does bring some new discovery quests sometimes, but also spams you with "develop sea lane"s.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Those "deliver trade goods that require fishing or procurement" quests like to crop up with this on, as well. Tip: accept one quest you have no use for (two, if you feel like spending cultural contribution) before using QMPs with this skill active. That helps lower the potential quest generation pool and, hopefully, will let you obtain the quest you're really after much quicker.

Does this skill really save QMP to take an unfinished discovery quest?

comments.author: Snipe
comments.body: if it replaces the finished discovery quests with blank then every time one uses a qmp it should show much lesser quests than 7-9 (provided he/she has done a lot of discoveries) if this is the case then what u said might be true but if its not then the skill most likely replaces finished discovery quests with quests that aren't completed by he/she, thus reducing qmp

comments.author: Egw
comments.body: I think the truth is somewhere in between. You certainly DON'T get 7-9 new discovery quests every time with this skill equipped. You do end up with a selection of 2-3 quests *sometimes*, of which 1, 2 or all can be "develop sea lane"s and such. On the other hand, you may sometimes see quests you couldn't easily see before. It seems to me it does two things, firstly it somewhat increases the chance of a new discovery quest to appear. Secondly, it does mask old discoveries in the final selection and leaves the spots blank. I'd guess it does reduce the QMPs needed, but not dramatically so.

comments.author: Egw
comments.body: ...these are what I've seen - when talking with others who've tried it, opinions vary from somewhat satisfied all the way down to utterly disappointed. I suggest you guys give it a go when you get the credits and see for yourselves :-).
